policy: ADR-0002 runtime escalation; Phase 4 single sitting on the macOS host; not a gate for static work

probes.question: How and when does Live start Ableton Index, with which arguments and options file contents?
probes.existing_evidence: entry 0x1001308e0 modes slave/standalone/os-notifications; options-file keys from 0x100673f10; Live.arm64 contains 'Ableton Index', 'live->index', option-key strings (out/live-arm64-index-strings.txt)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Spawn site, argv and option values are composed in Live, whose call sites are unresolved
probes.minimal_input: Start Live once with an empty user library
probes.discriminating_observation: argv of the 'Ableton Index' process; contents of each file named by --options-file (keys only plus value kinds); parent pid matches Live
probes.stopping_condition: One launch captured; also stop if the process is absent within 60 s of the main window appearing
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: What is the database file name and version recorded on disk?
probes.existing_evidence: name format '{}-files-{}.db' (0x10073559c); version getter returns 0x300c (0x100735594); version table (version, platform)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Prefix value and directory come from Live (db-path); the getter-to-file binding is inferred
probes.minimal_input: After probe 1, list the db-path directory
probes.discriminating_observation: File name equals <prefix>-files-12300.db or not; SELECT version, platform FROM version on a copy
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: Are new, renamed and deleted files in an indexed user folder reflected without restart, and how fast?
probes.existing_evidence: OsEvents strings (FSEvents streams, volume mount/unmount); 'Folders to be scanned fully, since they don't support OSEvents'; task phases change detection/extraction/update/remove
probes.why_static_insufficient: Event delivery, debounce and UI refresh are runtime behavior
probes.minimal_input: One user folder with three WAV files; add one, rename one, delete one while Live runs
probes.discriminating_observation: Browser listing and the files table after each step, with timestamps
probes.stopping_condition: All three changes visible, or 5 minutes elapsed per change
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: Where is a user tag assignment persisted?
probes.existing_evidence: export of pending metadata (flags|32), XMP writer messages for folder/pack/plugin/app-builtin, 'No UserLibrary. Can't write factory pack metadata', file-name patterns c55d131f…/b20da5c2…([-_]suffix)?.xmp
probes.why_static_insufficient: Target directory, file name and whether writes are immediate are runtime choices
probes.minimal_input: Tag one sample in a user folder and one preset in Core Library
probes.discriminating_observation: New or changed *.xmp files under any 'Ableton Folder Info' (path, name, ablFR:resource, item filePath and keywords)
probes.stopping_condition: Both writes located, or 2 minutes and a Live quit elapsed with no XMP change
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: What happens to an indexed file that is moved, deleted, or on an unmounted volume?
probes.existing_evidence: 'Index: Observed File is gone', DELETE FROM files with descendants, unavail_places (folder_kind 13), UpdateUnavailablePacks, RelocateFolder, RebindSafeUserData
probes.why_static_insufficient: Whether tags and colors survive a move and how unavailable places are shown is runtime behavior
probes.minimal_input: Tagged and colored sample on a removable volume; unmount, remount; move it within a user folder
probes.discriminating_observation: Browser state and keywords/colors rows before and after each step
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: How does Live react to a corrupt or foreign-version database?
probes.existing_evidence: 'database corrupted; must be fixed on next start-up', corrupted-database indicator file, version outcomes 1 upgrade / 2,3,4 recreate (0x10023344c, 0x100232eb4), copy of older '{}-files-' versions (0x10023af84, 0x10023b614)
probes.why_static_insufficient: User-visible messages are localized resources; rebuild timing and preservation of user data need execution
probes.minimal_input: (a) truncate a copy of the database file; (b) set version.version to 99999 on a copy; (c) set platform to another value; start Live each time
probes.discriminating_observation: Message shown (if any), indicator file presence, new file created, keywords restored from XMP or lost
probes.stopping_condition: Each variant observed through one restart cycle
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: Does Live use filerefmap.db to redirect legacy sample references when loading a set?
probes.existing_evidence: Index opens fileref-map-path read-only (0x100132970 -> 0x1005284c4); sample_mapping lookup by (src_type, src_packid, src_ref); shipped rows 37,617
probes.why_static_insufficient: Which component consults the map during document load, and the meaning of type values, are not established
probes.minimal_input: A set whose sample FileRef matches one shipped src row (type 2, empty pack id) with the destination pack installed
probes.discriminating_observation: Whether the sample loads from the dst_ref location and what the saved set then records
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: When is sound-similarity data computed and what enables it?
probes.existing_evidence: options sound-analyzer and auto-keywords; SetEnableSoundAnalyzer; fe_values with fe_version; Features.json in Core Library 'Ableton Folder Info'; feature-file validation messages (0x10017e380)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Scheduling, model inputs and preference wiring are runtime
probes.minimal_input: Fresh database; one user sample folder; toggle the relevant preference
probes.discriminating_observation: fe_values row count and ReportSoundAnalysisStatus-driven UI status before/after
probes.stopping_condition: Counts stable for 5 minutes after each toggle
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy

probes.question: How are unsupported or corrupt media files presented?
probes.existing_evidence: file-type registry (80 entries, out/file-type-registry.tsv), restricted-* file kinds, audio_decoding_failed and corrupt_document strings
probes.why_static_insufficient: Whether such files are listed, greyed or hidden is UI behavior
probes.minimal_input: A user folder with a truncated WAV, a zero-byte .als, a .xyz file and a .wma
probes.discriminating_observation: Browser listing and files rows for each
probes.environment: macOS host with Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (pinned identity); fresh macOS user account or a copied-aside Live preferences/database directory; capture ps output, the database directory listing and SQLite reads on a copy
